static_checks.message: Must use slackcli for Slack access
Must offer the fieldkit watch run slack-threads watcher pathway
Must offer the deterministic deal-room sweep pathway
Must note there is no Slack MCP server
Must declare the skill never posts to Slack
Must carry the unknown-user resolution rule

evals.prompt: what's happening in the deal rooms?
evals.expected_behavior: Collects deterministically (scan.py sweep and/or slack-threads watcher) before judging, resolves unknown user ids, then synthesizes ball-in-our-court / customer signals / team concerns per account
assertions: Collects before judging — runs the scan.py sweep or slack-threads watcher and reads the on-disk output rather than ad-hoc searching first
Resolves unresolved user ids via slackcli search people, marking failures [Unresolved: ...] instead of guessing
Synthesizes per account in the ball-in-our-court / customer signals / team concerns order
Labels surfaced items [Slack intel] and writes nothing to pursuit or account files without operator confirmation
Never posts, drafts, or sends Slack messages

evals.expected_behavior: Scopes the sweep to the named account, reports threads needing attention
assertions: Scopes collection to the named account (scan.py --account or watcher --account)
Flags unanswered threads or threads needing response
